data.description:
Stand up the Go service skeleton that BC-3, BC-4 and BC-5 build inside. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §2, §3, §5.1, §5.5 (envelope), §5.6, §11.

Why: every backend task needs the module, the router, the middleware chain and the shared domain types to exist first. Defining the shared types here lets BC-3 (domain logic) and BC-4 (store) run in parallel.

Scope:
- backend/go.mod, module path `brillio/backend`, `go 1.27`. Stdlib only.
- cmd/api/main.go: load config, build router, http.Server with Read/Write/Idle timeouts, graceful shutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM honoring SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT, slog JSON logger to stdout at LOG_LEVEL.
- internal/config: parse §11 env vars with defaults; invalid LOG_LEVEL or SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT is a startup error.
- internal/domain: types only. `Listing` per §4, `ListingStatus` with constants and `ParseStatus`, `SearchFilter{MinPrice, MaxPrice *float64; MinBedrooms *int; City, Keyword string; KeywordTokens []string; Statuses []ListingStatus}`. No logic.
- internal/httpapi: `NewRouter(deps Deps) http.Handler` using Go 1.22 ServeMux patterns. Middleware in order: request ID (echo X-Request-ID or generate 16 random bytes hex), request log line (method, path, status, duration, request id, remote addr), panic recovery to a 500 envelope, CORS per §5.6. JSON helpers `writeJSON` and `writeError` producing the §5.5 envelope. 404 and 405 handlers that return the envelope. GET /healthz returning {"status":"ok"} (DB ping arrives with BC-4; leave a `Pinger` interface in Deps that may be nil).
- backend/.golangci.yml: default linters plus errcheck, govet, staticcheck, revive.
- Root Makefile: fill in dev-api (go run ./cmd/api), and the backend halves of test (go test -race ./...), lint (golangci-lint run), check.
- Tests: config table; middleware (request id echoed and generated, panic becomes 500 envelope with no stack in body, CORS preflight 204 with the right headers, unknown route 404 envelope, wrong method 405 envelope).

Out of scope: SQLite, the search handler, OpenAPI, Docker.

Acceptance:
- `go run ./cmd/api` serves GET /healthz 200 with Content-Type application/json and an X-Request-ID header.
- `make lint` and `make test` pass for the backend.
- SIGTERM produces a "shutting down" log line and exit code 0.
- internal/domain compiles with the shared types and zero logic.

Validation: run the binary, curl /healthz with and without an X-Request-ID header, send SIGTERM, paste the output as evidence with --role validation.
data.title: Backend scaffold: Go 1.27 HTTP server with health, slog, request IDs, CORS, graceful shutdown, config, lint

data.body: From BC-1 review (f4f8a0b, nits forwarded): (1) root .gitignore deliberately does NOT ignore backend/api (would hide a future backend/api/ package) — build the binary to backend/bin/ (already ignored) or add an anchored rule for wherever you build; (2) repo .gitignore only ignores coverage.out and *.coverprofile for Go coverage — if test-api writes another filename (cover.out, coverage.html), add it. Note the host's global ~/.gitignore ignores *.out so the gap is invisible locally; test with git -c core.excludesFile=/dev/null check-ignore.

Plan-review triage (art_01M4W0VJ7731216A8G38XW3DTG, PASS): 4 findings, all obvious, folded into the plan as 'Plan-Review Cycle 1 Resolutions'. R1 ListedDate wire rule -> prescriptive doc comments + delegator posts handoff comments on BC-3/4/5 at review and mails Orchestrator for the run-state domain row. R2 httpapi tests use httptest.NewRecorder; HEAD row drops the empty-body assertion. R3 healthz 503 kept; BC-4 told at review. R4 config validation kept; rules listed in package doc. No evolutionary/complex items.

Code review art_01M4W1SKATQMGBTAQ2BWVXMEK5 PASS @ 5da9b80, 1 MINOR finding (CORS_ORIGINS accepts mixed-case host / trailing colon = dead config). Routed: fix (additive commit; normalize host to lowercase, reject empty port), plus remove redundant backend/.gitkeep. Re-review to follow on the new HEAD. Appended as 'Review Cycle 1 Findings' in the plan.

Review cycle 1 fix landed as a9b7f73 (CORS origins normalized to lowercase scheme+host, bare trailing colon rejected, uppercase scheme now accepted and lowercased; backend/.gitkeep removed; TestLoad 31->34 rows). Skipping fixer-noted edge cases (explicit default port :80/:443, leading-zero or >65535 port, non-punycode IDN host, post-normalization duplicates): evolutionary, operator-supplied config only, the default origin is correct, and none affects any SPEC behavior; not worth a ticket.

Re-review art_01M4W2E06P2SMDVN8PGN8XWYVK PASS @ a9b7f73 (82 tests, lint 0 issues, live binary checks incl. SIGTERM exit 0). Routing: (1) [MINOR] CORS origins with default/leading-zero ports (:80, :443, :08080) are dead config -> SKIP: same edge-case class already ruled out of scope after cycle 1; operator-supplied config only, the default origin is correct, no SPEC behavior affected, and another fix->re-review cycle would chase an unbounded tail of URL-serialization cases. (2) [MINOR] nil-Logger default in NewRouter untested -> SKIP: a two-line nil check whose regression is not silent (the first downstream test that builds Deps{} without a logger panics immediately); not worth spending the second and final fix->re-review cycle. Advancing to in_validation with the PASS naming HEAD a9b7f73.

Delegator completion (HEAD a9b7f73, in_validation, LAND-READY sent). Built: backend Go module brillio/backend (go 1.27, stdlib only, no go.sum); cmd/api wiring with slog JSON, Read/Write/Idle timeouts, SIGINT/SIGTERM graceful shutdown honoring SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT ('shutting down' -> exit 0); internal/config Load(getenv) with section 11 defaults and startup validation; internal/domain types only (Listing, ListingStatus + ParseStatus/AllStatuses, SearchFilter, DateLayout); internal/httpapi NewRouter(Deps) with requestID -> request log -> panic recovery -> CORS -> 404/405 envelope fallbacks (ServeMux.Handler probe, Allow preserved), writeJSON/writeError section 5.5 envelope, GET /healthz with nil-able Pinger and 503 degraded branch; .golangci.yml v2 (standard + errcheck, govet, staticcheck, revive); Makefile BC-2 block (dev-api builds bin/api and runs from repo root; lint-api; test-api); .gitignore backend lines (BC-1 nits closed). Tests: 82 runs, 0 fail, -race. Deviations: dev-api runs the built binary from the repo root instead of 'go run' in backend/ (so ./data defaults resolve after BC-4); /healthz 503 implemented now; config validation broader than the ticket (PORT, CORS_ORIGINS); no SPEC edits. Findings routed: plan review 4 obvious (folded); code review cycle 1 one minor fixed (a9b7f73); re-review two minors skipped with justification. Downstream handoffs: ListedDate wire rule commented on BC-3/4/5; BC-4 told healthz 503 exists. Follow-up tickets: none.
